verdict.rationale: Ghostty's config is a plain-text file (config-file key), supports splitting into multiple files for modular dotfiles, every key works as a CLI flag, and it can be reloaded live without restart, all of which make it straightforward to keep in a dotfiles repo and sync across machines. missing for 10: no explicit documentation or community confirmation of cross-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows) path consistency for the config file, and no first-party dotfiles-sync tooling or guide is mentioned.
